content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notice advertises a total of 01 (one) post for Project Officer (Disaster Management) under ASDMA.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfil the following essential and desirable qualification, experience, and age criteria to apply for the post: Essential Qualification: Graduate degree in any discipline from a recognised University or Institute or equivalent. Desirable Qualification: Preference will be given to candidates having a degree or diploma in Disaster Management. Experience: Minimum 2 (two) years working experience as a full-time paid employee in an organisation of repute dealing with Disaster Management. Additional requirements include knowledge of Disaster Risk Reduction, computer skills (especially MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Internet use), and excellent communication skills in Assamese and English. Age Limit: Should not be below 21 years and above 42 years as on 01-01-2026.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The total cost to ASDMA for the Project Officer (Disaster Management) position is Rs. 37,000/- per month, which includes Rs. 30,000/- as remuneration, Rs. 6,000/- as mobility allowance, and Rs. 1,000/- as communication charges. Compensation is subject to Income Tax and Assam Professional Tax deductions. The contract is for a period of one year, subject to renewal based on performance and availability of funds under SDRF. Performance is evaluated through a grading system linked to increments (5% for A+, 4% for A, 3% for B+, 0% for B, and termination for C).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ASDMA Project Officer (Disaster Management)
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form from the official ASDMA website. Fill out the application form completely in capital letters. Enclose attested copies of all educational certificates, mark sheets, work experience certificates, and 3 recent passport-size photographs. Write the application clearly for the post of Project Officer (DM). Send the completed application by post to The State Project Coordinator, Assam State Disaster Management Authority (ASDMA), Ancillary Block-I (Opp. SBI Sectt. Branch), Janata Bhawan, Dispur, Guwahati- 781006, Assam, so that it reaches on or before 15-10-2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Project Officers shall be selected through a selection procedure conducted by ASDMA. Shortlisted candidates based on eligibility criteria may be required to appear for a Written Test, Computer Test, or Interview. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the test or interview.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Project Officer (Disaster Management) post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely on a contract basis for a period of one year, subject to renewal based on performance and fund availability under SDRF.

faq.question: Q2. Are allowances paid on top of the base remuneration?
faq.answer: The total cost to ASDMA is Rs. 37,000/- per month, which inclusive of Rs. 30,000/- remuneration, Rs. 6,000/- mobility allowance, and Rs. 1,000/- communication charges.

faq.question: Q3. Who gets preference during the shortlisting process?
faq.answer: Preference will be given to candidates having a degree or diploma in Disaster Management, alongside fulfilling the graduate degree and 2 years of work experience requirements.

faq.question: Q4. How are candidates shortlisted for the selection stages?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on eligibility criteria, and shortlisted applicants may be called for a Written Test, Computer Test, or Interview as decided by the Authority.

faq.question: Q5. What documents must be enclosed with the application form?
faq.answer: Applicants must enclose attested copies of all educational certificates, mark sheets, work experience certificates, and 03 copies of recent passport-size photographs along with the prescribed application form.
